purpose: One bounded first-block CPOP adaptation for isolated-spike fragmentation, compared to unchanged native CPOP and author LABS. No forecasting, effects or formal-report work.
hypothesis: Locally isolated extremes can induce short fitted segments and fragment duration. Data-dependent downweighting may reduce this, but true one-bin actions are not distinguishable from measurement spikes from this signal alone.

candidate.name: cpop_isolated_weight_v1
candidate.neighbors: left/right two-point median agreement<=2.5sigma; within-side range<=3sigma; local scale=max(declared sigma,1.4826MAD of four neighbors)
candidate.effective_sigma: max(base sigma,abs(local residual)/kappa) only when abs residual>kappa*local scale
candidate.command_protection: never downweight point within one bin of any observed command change
candidate.flag_meaning: ambiguous isolated measurement or real short action; not a fault classification
candidate.core: Existing CPOP vector-sd interface; same beta2log(n)/grid/minseglen0/exact prune; no new DP or globally robust-loss theorem claimed

comparators.cpop: Existing production original scalar-sd adapter unchanged
comparators.labs: Original author commit0bb0524dec39336a2e0d032287ce092e2968145a, M5/retest2/sSIC, no new tuning

shared_information: All methods have same command/task/time/reference/measurement/noise metadata. New candidate uses command changes for edge protection. No truth or kind flags reach estimators.

domain.reference: Explicit known simulation untreated baseline; no predictor. Not unknown-reference field proof.

simulation.generator: Reuse immutable prior independent first/second-order ODE block with new seeds; append honest one-bin response and one-bin gap safeguards, no candidate-driven truth generation.
simulation.spikes: Exactly two independent signed uniform0.4..0.9kW additions to measured residual at two distinct uniformly drawn task bins; same Gaussian fact across paired conditions. Indices/labels are evaluator metadata unavailable to fitting.

selection: Among kappa3/4/5 with complete validation outputs, minimize equal-condition mean of cumulative/longest duration absolute error averaged, seconds. Break exact ties by larger kappa (conservative); freeze once before test. No grid enlargement or test-based switch; validation may select a candidate that still fails safety gates.
secondary: onset/target/recovery timing with missing status and all denominators

real_auxiliary.source: Reuse frozen KIT144 cases/18 recordings, not a new real holdout
real_auxiliary.reference: Original100ms observed descriptors, not latent clean truth. Also same-method Gaussian->Gaussian+spikes paired changes.
real_auxiliary.units: seconds, current-step normalized progress; RIDE not applied

stop: One candidate family and one new test. Negative safety results prevent adoption; no chasing test or dropping short actions, no default/source rewrite, no additional method sweep, no dependency install/GPU/delete/report/second block/B2B3B4/upload/commit.
